title: LLMOps & Agentic Systems
prereqs: Local LLM via Ollama or an API key (optional — most challenges mock the model)
description: Operating LLMs & agents in production: how LLMOps differs from MLOps (prompts, non-determinism, eval, cost), prompt & model versioning, evaluation at scale (LLM-as-judge, regression suites), guardrails & safety (structured output, PII, prompt-injection defense), agentic systems (tool routing, multi-agent, loop & cost control), serving economics (semantic caching, batching, routing/fallback), and LLM observability (token/latency/cost tracing, output drift) — deterministic and pytest-judged, with the model mocked where needed.
